info.title: dt-docs: build and lint a project docs site.
info.description: Builds and checks a project docs site: Docusaurus with sections and sign-in from docs-settings.yml, keys that link any page to a spot on another, and checks of every page's front matter, links and headings. Bundles Bun and the site, so it needs nothing else installed.

commands.name: agent
commands.description: Answer a deployed site's chat window from this machine

commands.name: build
commands.description: Lint, then build the site into build/, its access rules included

commands.name: dev
commands.description: Serve the site locally, reloading as you edit

commands.name: find
commands.description: Print where a key is defined, or every key starting with it

commands.name: guide
commands.description: Print the writing guide for a kind of page

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Lint the settings, pages and keys

commands.name: new
commands.description: Create a page from a page template

commands.name: pages
commands.description: Print every page's path, title and description, by section

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Serve the last build, with search
